modern: Often consider the connection of all things in the universe and their relation to one another. For in a way all things are bound up with one another, and in this way all are friendly to one another; for one thing comes in order after another, and this is because of the active movement and the working together and the unity of the substance.
original: Frequently consider the connection of all things in the universe and their relation to one another. For in a manner all things are implicated with one another, and all in this way are friendly to one another; for one thing comes in order after another, and this is by virtue of the active movement and mutual conspiration and the unity of the substance.
